history_policy: Historical RS ranks are recomputed from downloaded split-adjusted Yahoo OHLC using the current universe; exact PIT membership is unavailable for reconstructed dates. Exact observed sessions override reconstructed windows.

definition.再浮上: previously outside Top24 and current Top10 streak >=5
definition.失速中: 21-session rank worsens >=8 or both RS63 and RS126 decline
definition.定着: Top10>=15/21 and Top24>=75% and long-term RS not deteriorating
definition.新規急浮上: 21-session rank improves >=10 and recently enters Top10

source: Yahoo adjusted OHLC current-universe reconstruction + observed V38 session archive + current RS universe
